name: Wither
body:
Discipline: psychometabolism; Level: vitalist 4, psion/wilder 4

MANIFESTING

Display: Visual
Manifesting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: touch
Target: Creature touched
Duration: instantaneous
Saving Throw: Fort negates; Power Resistance: Yes
Power Points: 7

DESCRIPTION

Your touch disrupts the target’s physical form, draining the strength from its muscles. The creature suffers 2d4 points of Strength damage. A successful Fortitude save halves the Strength damage taken.

Augment: For each additional 4 power points spent, this power causes an additional 1d4 points of Strength damage.
